# Changes to miniaudio.h

`miniaudio.h` is miniaudio 0.11.25 (public domain or MIT No Attribution, see `LICENSE`),
https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio. It is unchanged except for the functions
below. Re-apply it when updating, or drop it if upstream has an equivalent.

| Where | What and why |
|---|---|
| `ma_dr_flac__seek_to_pcm_frame__binary_search_internal` (dr_flac, marked "FatzAudio patch") | Seeking a `.flac` without a SEEKTABLE (FatzAudio's own encoder writes none, nor does FFmpeg's) used a bisection that took up to 11 probes (one frame decode each) per seek on a 14 s test file, and up to 16 on real music. The replacement interpolates between the closest known frames either side, aiming one block before the target, and bisects twice whenever a probe fails to halve the range, so typical files seek in 2 to 4 probes. The same function searches between the points of a SEEKTABLE, which gets faster too (8 probes down to 5 with a point every 3.7 s). Probes read only the frame header (`ma_dr_flac__seek_to_approximate_flac_frame_to_byte` calls the new `ma_dr_flac__fa_read_next_stream_frame_header`, which also skips headers whose block size, channels or sample rate don't fit the stream, and the search skips one whose frame number is out of order with the frames it has found, or past the end); the frame the search ends on is decoded and CRC-16 checked (or the next good one, when it fails), so a seek lands on exactly the same samples. On a 24-bit file that cut the reads per seek by a third. Long digital silence before music is the worst case: up to 15 probes against upstream's 11. A probe that finds a new upper frame within two blocks past the target does not count as failing to halve the range, so it doesn't bisect (finding the same upper frame again still does). `ma_dr_flac__read_next_flac_frame_header` treats a header with the wrong bits per sample, or a 16-bit block size of 65536, as a false sync and looks on (upstream ends the search there, before the CRC-8 is even read, and a seek in 24-bit audio then decoded from the start: 15 ms instead of 0.5). Tested by `test_flac_seek_search` in `tests/test_core.c`. |
